---
title: "validationConfig_publication"
output: html_document
---

Validation of REMIND scenarios as used in

> Weigmann, P., Mandaroux, R., Lécuyer, F., Merfort, A., Dorndorf, T., Hoppe, J., Müßel, J., Pietzcker, R., Richters, O., Baumstark, L., Kriegler, E., Bauer, N., Benke, F., Gong, C. C., and Luderer, G.: Validation of climate mitigation pathways, EGUsphere [preprint], https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-2025-2284, 2025. 

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(readr)
library(DT)

# Load the CSV from inst/config
df <- piamValidation::getConfig("publication")

# drop columns that are empty in this config
empty_cols <- names(df)[colSums(!is.na(df)) == 0]
df <- df[, colSums(!is.na(df)) > 0, drop = FALSE]

if (length(empty_cols) > 0) {
  cat("*Columns that are empty in this config and therefore not shown:*",
      paste0("`", empty_cols, "`", collapse = ", "))
}

DT::datatable(
  df,
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "220px", targets = which(names(df) == "variable") - 1)
    )
  )
)

```
